name: awesome-cc98
description: A verified catalog and digital museum of CC98 clients.

scripts.museum:dev: pnpm generate && pnpm museum:prepare && pnpm --filter @awesome-cc98/museum dev
scripts.museum:build: pnpm generate && pnpm museum:prepare && pnpm --filter @awesome-cc98/museum build
scripts.check: pnpm validate && pnpm generate:check && pnpm test && pnpm museum:build
